description: Push one order to the company's connected online store (WooCommerce): creates it there the first time, updates it afterwards, and syncs its notes. Use ONLY when the merchant says an order is missing from or stale in their online store — 'this sale never showed up in WooCommerce'. CONFIRM WITH THE MERCHANT BEFORE CALLING, naming the order: it writes into their live store and nothing here can undo it. It changes NOTHING in Final POS — it is not a way to change status, cancel an order or refund anything. Companies with no supported platform connected get a no-op.

orderId.description: Order id from get_orders — not a receipt number

name: hub_sync_order_to_ecommerce
title: Sync order to store
